plugins.name: graft-robotics
plugins.description: Full Anthropic MCP & Claude Code robotics plugin (15 MCP tools): interactive Graft Workbench MCP App, 4 interactive MCP Form Elicitations (ctx.elicit), 6 operational Playbooks (MCP Prompts + slash commands), 5 live MCP Resources, PreToolUse safety guardrail hooks, 6-family Hand HAL, Rust graft-core + MuJoCo 4.0.1 LAN LiDAR mesh collision physics, Semantic-to-Deterministic Ratchet, material crush/slip mechanics, progressive L0-L3 Trust Ladder, RoboCurve SET-Sim rehearsal, and uv-first client LLM bundles.
mcpApps: Graft Robotics Workbench (ui://graft-robotics/workbench.html, aux_pane, global, Claude MCP App)
suggestedPrompts: Run /remote-shop-onboarding to generate a zero-FDE CNC or shop-floor onboarding kit and 48h L0 shadow trial
Run /shift-start-preflight to inspect sensors, bounds, and world model freshness
Open the Graft Robotics Workbench side pane and inspect our robot cell
Run /semantic-hazard-ratchet to crystallize an unlabeled chemical hazard into a permanent deterministic rule
Generate a uv-first on-premises air-gapped bundle for a Raspberry Pi 5 + UR5e CNC cell

plugins.name: robot-md
plugins.description: Bounded physical-AI robotics plugin: live SO-ARM101 telemetry console (MCP App), robot_doctor fault isolation, ROBOT.md workspace checks, and castor-hal guidance.
suggestedPrompts: Open the Robot-MD Console side pane and check live SO-ARM101 bus telemetry
Run robot_doctor to check hardware reachability and servo voltages
Test whether (650, 0, 120) mm is inside the ROBOT.md workspace envelope

plugins.name: graftfork
plugins.description: Test-gated upstream fork carry assistant: interactive Carry Inspector MCP App, local fork status analysis, and GraftFork CLI/MCP workflow skills.
suggestedPrompts: Open the GraftFork Inspector side pane and check our fork carry status
Inspect my local git fork to see commits ahead of upstream and conflict risk
Check GraftFork's public benchmark results and test-gate rules
